description: Retrieve a release-eligible kingy.wiki guide or section with source links, build/evidence caveats and a content hash. Structured safe sections and public excerpts are returned by default. Unclassified full bodies and solution details are available with include_spoilers=true. next_offset paginates long content. Also returns up to 25 clip moments for the page or section: the creator's YouTube watch link at the exact start second, channel name and link, the date Kingy checked it on screen, the kingy.wiki moment link and a ready citation. Spoiler clips need include_spoilers=true. This tool does not execute interactive calculators.
name: get_guide
title: Read a Kingy Guide
